sources.entry: Firefox Account Server - Host your own Firefox accounts server. (Source Code) MPL-2.0 Nodejs/Java

summary.one_liner: Mozilla Accounts (formerly Firefox Accounts) monorepo, the source for Mozilla's account service, which the awesome-selfhosted list describes as a Firefox account server you can host yourself.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only describes the repository as the Mozilla Accounts monorepo, formerly Firefox Accounts and still abbreviated fxa. It has three sections: Getting Started, which points to external documentation; Contributing, which points to a separate CONTRIBUTING.md; and Documentation, which says the Firefox Ecosystem Platform is the documentation hub for Mozilla Accounts and Subscription Platform. The README does not describe specific features, setup steps, or architecture. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a Firefox account server you can host yourself, with Node.js and Java noted in the metadata.
use_cases: run a private account sign-in service
how_to_run: See the external documentation referenced in the README (Firefox Ecosystem Platform); the README gives no install commands
notable: Monorepo for Mozilla Accounts, formerly Firefox Accounts
Documentation hosted on the Firefox Ecosystem Platform
Contribution guidelines are in a separate CONTRIBUTING.md file
caveats: The README is minimal and gives no self-hosting or installation instructions; setup details must come from the external documentation
Covers Mozilla Accounts and Subscription Platform, so it may be a large multi-part project rather than a single self-hosted app
